value.rationale: A foundational 2026 attempt to distinguish oscillatory evolutionary stability by a universally strict mean-fitness inequality becomes vacuous for every nonconstant periodic population state. The result detects a structural obstruction and gives an actual dynamical counter-mutant, requiring a mathematically substantive repair to the proposed definition. It does not merely negate a numerical example and does not disprove stable limit cycles.
